entry.title: New: BILL057(24) (Honolulu) — Councilmember Nishimoto took office on January 2, 2025.
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Allows an owners’ association to apply for the automatic sprinkler system tax credit on behalf of eligible owners within the existing high-rise residential building. Applies to the tax years beginning July 1, 2026 and thereafter.

Latest action: Councilmember Nishimoto took office on January 2, 2025.
